project.description: The project in which the instance belongs. If it is not provided, Terraform will use the provider default.
project.rationale: Non-secret project id for the Terraform resource; actual access grants still come from `member`/`members` + `role`, not from repeating the project id here.

instance.description: The name or relative resource ID of the Bigtable instance for member/binding resources.
instance.rationale: Selects the Bigtable instance resource to attach the binding to; it is a target reference, not a credential and not the list of who is allowed.

member/members.description: Identities granted the privilege in `role` (`member` on `google_bigtable_instance_iam_member`, `members` on binding). Includes special principals such as allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers.
member/members.rationale: Defines who receives the role on the instance; public principals broaden access beyond least privilege.

role.description: The role to grant. Custom roles use `[projects|organizations]/{parent}/roles/{role-name}`. See Bigtable IAM roles in GCP docs.
role.rationale: The role id describes permissions only; without a principal (`member`/`members`) it grants nothing—similar to naming an api role without attaching a caller.

condition.description: Optional IAM condition that limits when this binding applies.
condition.rationale: The parent block for optional conditional IAM; the block being present does not by itself add or remove a member—security impact is in the nested `expression` and in which principal is bound.

expression.description: CEL expression evaluated when the condition is enforced.
expression.rationale: Constrains when a binding is active; misconfiguration can widen effective access, but the expression text itself is policy logic—not a password—and still sits behind IAM’s principal checks.

title.description: Short title for the IAM condition in consoles.
title.rationale: UI metadata for operators only; not evaluated for authorization decisions.

description.description: Longer description of the IAM condition.
description.rationale: Optional prose documentation; ignored by IAM enforcement engines.

policy_data.description: For `google_bigtable_instance_iam_policy` only: the policy document from a `google_iam_policy` data source.
policy_data.rationale: A container for the rendered IAM policy body; the attribute is the delivery mechanism—actual grants are in the policy’s bindings, not the fact that this field exists.
